About furnACE furnACE × Gecko in the Village

A local maker, made for your shelves.

furnACE is a handcrafted timber art and décor brand based in Helensville, West Auckland. Every piece is designed in-house and made in small batches using traditional woodworking, precision laser detailing, hand-finishing and careful assembly. The range celebrates New Zealand's native birds, landscapes and rural textures: pieces that feel genuinely local, giftable and distinctive, not mass-produced souvenir shelf-fillers.

Shared values

Nature as the muse

The whole furnACE range is built around Aotearoa's native birds, ruru, kōtare, tūī, pīwakawaka, kea, kiwi, and the landscapes they live in. It speaks the same language as the makers Gecko already champions.

Supporting local

One maker, one workshop

Designed, cut, finished and packed by hand in Helensville. Buying furnACE is backing a New Zealand maker directly, with small-batch replenishment and no importer in the middle.

The gap it fills

Dimensional timber art

Layered, raised timber pieces with real depth and shadow, a look that sits apart from flat metal silhouettes, prints and ceramics. A fresh point of difference in the wall-art bay.

Easy to sell

Proven price points

Strong gift-shop bands from $39 to $109 RRP, with clear native-bird subjects customers recognise instantly. Easy to display, easy to explain, easy to gift.

Why this works for Gecko

A range that replenishes, not just restocks.

furnACE is designed for sustainable small-batch supply, so a successful line can be reordered and kept on shelf without long lead times or import cycles. We suggest starting with a focused opening range across proven gift price points, then building from there as lines prove themselves in-store.

Consistent 50%Clean wholesale structure across the range. (Hand-cast chess set carries a tighter trade margin.)

Trade Terms Wholesale supply · June 2026

Simple terms, direct from the maker.

A straightforward wholesale arrangement designed to keep good lines on your shelves and easy to reorder.

Pricing & Orders

  • Wholesale = 50% of RRP across every SKU. All prices NZD, GST-inclusive (15%).
  • Minimum order quantities apply per SKU as listed, sized for gift retail, not bulk.
  • Opening order can mix any SKUs to reach a workable first delivery; we'll advise lead times at point of order.
  • Reorders via small-batch replenishment direct from the workshop.

Supply & Presentation

  • Retail-ready: pieces arrive boxed or wrapped, with hanging hardware or USB fittings included where relevant.
  • Made to order in small batches, designs and colourways can be rotated season to season.
  • Samples available for inspection by appointment.
  • Full range & new releases viewable any time at furnace.nz.
A note on the range

Start focused, grow with what sells.

We'd suggest opening with the recommended selection on page 3, the proven gift price points, and expanding into the fuller range as lines establish themselves in your stores. As a single workshop, we'd rather supply a focused range reliably than over-commit on day one. That keeps quality consistent and shelves replenished.
